description: The action block: runs an action of a node with its arguments, on trigger, on a changed argument (auto_run), every interval_ms or when in arrives (a command: the deployer proves the right, ADR 0008).

params.description: The node: downstream/<link>/… or storage/…
params.name: path

params.description: The action's name.
params.name: action

params.description: Its arguments: each key is a field with the port arg.<name>; the value is the argument's constant until a sample replaces it ("$in": the last value on in).
params.name: args

params.description: For in: every sample, a rising or falling bool, or a change.
params.name: on

params.description: Run on samples of bad quality too.
params.name: allow_bad

params.description: Runs every this many milliseconds, first one full period after the start; 0: off (default), else 100 … 86 400 000.
params.name: interval_ms

params.description: Run when an argument changes on its port (default false).
params.name: auto_run

params.description: false: nothing runs it (default true).
params.name: enabled

params.description: WARNING: true runs this command once every time the flow starts: at each deploy, hot swap, reload and broker restart (default false: a start never runs a command).
params.name: run_on_start

description: An event when in becomes true.

params.description: The point: downstream/<link>/… or storage/…
params.name: path

params.description: With auto_run: every sample, or a changed value only.
params.name: on

params.description: With on change: a smaller change is not written.
params.name: deadband

params.description: Write values of bad quality too.
params.name: allow_bad

params.description: Runs every this many milliseconds, first one full period after the start; 0: off (default), else 100 … 86 400 000.
params.name: interval_ms

params.description: Write when in brings a value (default true); false: only on trigger and interval_ms.
params.name: auto_run

params.description: false: nothing runs it (default true).
params.name: enabled

description: The value of a point (its ~val) as it changes: numbers, text, any value the point has. To know whether a node is there at all, use liveliness. in.key names another point inside key_scope.

params.description: A point of this site: downstream/<link>/…, storage/… or wy/<site>/… (may be absent when in.key brings it).
params.name: key

params.description: The keys in.key may name, a key expression: downstream/<link>/** (required when in.key is wired; the deployer must read all of it).
params.name: key_scope
